claims: Morocco was declared the winner of the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON) in March 2026.
Confederation of African Football (CAF) overturned the initial result of the 2025 AFCON.
CAF reversed a 1-0 loss to Senegal for Morocco.
As of 2026, Egypt holds the record for most AFCON wins.
As of 2026, Cameroon follows Egypt for most AFCON wins.
As of 2026, Ghana follows Cameroon for most AFCON wins.
Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON) is held every two years.
Morocco defeated Senegal 3-0 by forfeit in the 2025 AFCON.
BBC and Sky Sports say the 2025 AFCON final was officially overturned following a dispute regarding a penalty protest.
